title: Exploring Ratsputin's Gulag
description: Exploring Ratsputin's Gulag — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Explore

Quest Description: Explore many branches connected to Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston. Involves visiting the locations: The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section, Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1 and The Whisker's Library - Edict Section.

Quest Reward: 56250 Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile in Townston

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Explore the many branches connected to Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

To be honest, even though I studied Ratsputin, and even lived in the dungeon for time, I actually know very little.... He is an enigma, wrapped in a limerick, tossed in a chipotle of truth flavored vinaigrette, then cave aged until it is so funky no one would ever want to actually taste it! All there really is to know about him is that he is almost impossible to kill, but it is beyond doubt that he must be stopped!

Get into the dungeon and become familiar with it and when you have done so return to me, Loremaster Vraile, in Townston.

Turn-in:

So you have seen more of Ratsputin's Gulag. Is it not a vile place?!

Objectives:

  • Explore The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section
  • Explore Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 1
  • Explore The Whisker's Library - Edict Section

Client level range: 75–100
